source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves apostolic claim and the explicitly maternal caregiving image.
key_decisions.before: though as Christ’s apostles we could have made demands. Instead, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring tenderly for her own children.
key_decisions.after: Though we could have asserted our weight as Christ's apostles, we became gentle among you, like a nursing mother tenderly caring for her own children.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her own children.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps intense affection and self-sharing beyond speech.
key_decisions.before: Having such deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God’s good news but also our own lives, because you had become beloved to us.
key_decisions.after: Because we yearned for you, we were pleased to share with you not only God's good news but our own lives as well, since you had become dear to us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So, having deep affection for you, we were pleased to share with you not only the good news of God but also our own lives, because you had become dear to us.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps local perpetrators distinct and does not generalize the polemic beyond the comparison.
key_decisions.before: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Christ Jesus that are in Judea, because you suffered the same things from your own people as they did from some of their Judean opponents,
key_decisions.after: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God's churches in Judea that are in Christ Jesus: you suffered the same things from your own compatriots as they did from the Judeans
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you became imitators, brothers and sisters, of the churches of God that are in Judea in Christ Jesus, because you suffered the same things from your own people as they did from the Jews,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the source's severe accusations as the letter's rhetoric without softening them.
key_decisions.before: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They displease God and oppose all people
key_decisions.after: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets and drove us out. They displease God and oppose everyone,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove us out, and do not please God and are hostile to all people,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the prohibited mission, accumulated sins and judgment claim.
key_decisions.before: by hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so they may be saved. In this way they keep filling up their sins. But wrath has come upon them to the end.
key_decisions.after: hindering us from speaking to the nations so that they may be saved. In this way they always fill up their sins. But wrath has overtaken them at last.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved—so as always to fill up their sins. But wrath has come upon them at last.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the unusual orphan image and face/heart contrast.
key_decisions.before: But we, brothers and sisters, after being separated from you for a short time—in person, not in heart—made every effort, with great desire, to see you face to face.
key_decisions.after: But when we were orphaned from you, brothers and sisters, for a short time—in person, not in heart—we made every effort, with great longing, to see you face to face.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But we, brothers and sisters, having been torn away from you for a short time—in person, not in heart—endeavored all the more eagerly with great desire to see your face,
